descriptor.title: Figure 1 — plasma meropenem after 20 mg/kg IV, six species (digitized)
descriptor.source_notes:
Figure 1 — plasma meropenem after 20 mg/kg IV, six species (digitized)
S01 | DOI 10.11250/chemotherapy1953.40.Supplement1_123 | Fig. 1 (Sumita et al. 1992, Chemotherapy 40 Suppl 1:123-131)
Meropenem 20 mg/kg single IV bolus in all species (salt/hydrate basis not stated); plasma assayed by bioassay; time in min.
Animals (S01 methods, Japanese text): mouse ICR male 20-25 g; rat SD male 190-200 g; guinea pig Hartley male 350-450 g; rabbit Japanese white male 2.4-3.0 kg; dog beagle male 8.7-13.5 kg; monkey rhesus male 6.0-7.3 kg.
Digitized from a 400-dpi render of the published figure; log y axis calibrated on the printed ticks 0.05-100 µg/ml; x calibrated on ticks 5-120 min. Reading uncertainty about ±5% of value.
Series identified by the curve labels printed in the figure (mouse filled circle, rat open circle, guinea pig filled triangle, rabbit open triangle, dog filled square, monkey open square). The caption does not state mean, SD or n; n per species is given only in Table 1.
Overlap flags: Mouse/Rat at 5 and 30 min, Guinea pig/Rabbit at 5 and 15 min, Dog/Monkey at 15, 60 and 90 min overlap and were split by marker edges; Dog and Monkey at 30 min overlap completely and were given the same value.
Empty cells: no marker plotted. These are digitized means, not individual animals.

descriptor.title: MICs and fT>MIC of ESBL and non-ESBL isolates, humanized regimen in mouse thigh
descriptor.source_notes:
MICs and fT>MIC of ESBL and non-ESBL isolates, humanized regimen in mouse thigh
S05 | DOI 10.1128/aac.00752-06 | Table 1 (DeRyke et al. 2007)
Neutropenic female ICR mice about 25 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.) made renally impaired with uranyl nitrate 5 mg/kg i.p. 3 days before inoculation. Thigh inoculum about 10^5 CFU/ml standard (10^7 CFU/ml high inoculum for three isolates); treatment from 2 h after inoculation.
Meropenem 65, 30, 20, 5 mg/kg s.c. (0.2 ml) at 0, 1.5, 3, 5 h, repeated every 8 h over 24 h, to mimic human 1 g q8h (Fig. 1 legend says 60/30/20/5); groups of 3 mice; thighs harvested at 24 h. Ertapenem comparator regimen 50 mg/kg q6h. Serum PK by HPLC; sampling times and n per time not stated.
Protein binding 8% assumed for mice and humans. Footnotes: a median of >=3 MIC experiments; b fT>MIC in mice; c non-ESBL isolate; d removed from analysis (no infection established); e difference between meropenem and ertapenem efficacies.
Ertapenem columns are a comparator drug. Per-isolate CFU changes are in Fig. 3 only (not transcribed). Non-doubling MICs (e.g. 0.047) printed as is.

descriptor.title: Population PK/PD parameters, P. aeruginosa pneumonia model (plasma and ELF)
descriptor.source_notes:
Population PK/PD parameters, P. aeruginosa pneumonia model (plasma and ELF)
S06 | DOI 10.1128/aac.01559-10 | Table 2 (Drusano et al. 2011)
Neutropenic female Swiss-Webster mice 24-26 g (cyclophosphamide 150 mg/kg day -4 and 100 mg/kg day -1 i.p.); intranasal P. aeruginosa PAO1 2 × 10^7 CFU. PK: single i.p. doses spanning 2.4-150 mg/kg given to four groups 5 h after inoculation (individual doses not listed); 11 times over 0-5 h, 2-3 mice per time; plasma and urea-corrected BAL (ELF) by LC-MS/MS.
Efficacy: "Five animal cohorts were administered meropenem i.p. at doses of 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, and 450 mg/kg every 4 h" (five cohorts but six doses, as printed) from 5 h after inoculation; lungs harvested 24 h after the start of therapy. Mice per cohort not stated; 5 mice killed for baseline counts.
Concentrations are in Figs. 1-2 only (not transcribed). Vc/F and CL/F are per animal (liters, liters/h), not per kg. Protein binding not reported. Table read once from the journal HTML.
Text: ELF penetration about 40% (median 39%); exposure targets "31.7%, 49.6%, and 49.8% of the dosing interval" time > MIC in ELF (abstract: 32%, 50%, 50%); endpoint mapping (2-log kill, 3-log kill, resistance suppression) paraphrased, NOT_VERIFIED. Strain MIC 0.5 to 1.0 mg/L.
